item.title: Baldur's Gate 3 is not only a poor Baldur's Gate, but also overrated on its own merits
item.description:
I was going to comment in the other BG3 thread, but it had already been archived. Three years later, the honeymoon period over this game has ended, and folk who disagree with the praise are now less likely to summon a mob when voicing their opinion. Let's begin, shall we?

* Larian's game required - and still requires - patching two years after release. That the public by-and-large accepts what is effectively an extended beta-testing period does not make the practice acceptable.
